publication.headline: Data Engineer
publication.bio: I engineer software, data platforms, and AI systems that move difficult ideas into reliable production.

items.title: About
items.public_summary: Software taught me structure. Data taught me scale. AI taught me to keep asking better questions.

items.title: Software Engineer

items.title: Data Engineer

items.title: Senior Data Engineer
items.public_summary: Designed dependable data platforms that balance scale, quality, and operational clarity.

items.title: AI Engineer
items.public_summary: Turned uncertain questions into evaluated AI systems with retrieval, citations, and safe abstention.

items.title: Portfolio as Proof
items.subtitle: A real product, built to make the work inspectable.
items.public_summary: An evidence-backed portfolio with a private Career Brain, retrieval, application preparation, interview support, and resilient public publishing.

blog.title: Notes from making solutions people actually use
blog.excerpt: Field notes on turning difficult engineering problems into systems people can trust.
blog.markdown: Reliable systems are made in the seams: clear contracts, useful feedback, and enough evidence to know when an answer should be trusted.
